lines.text: It starts to rain on a grey street. @maya_front opens a bright yellow @umbrella_open and grins up at the sky.
Slow push in; the yellow is the only colour.

new_beats.text: Let it rain. You've got colour to spare.

writes.note: I added one VO beat at 1.5 s and kept your words as they were.

reply.rationale: The VO sits over the opening rain and the umbrella reveal. It is short enough to fit the shot without crowding the action.
